name: Chakra UI v3
licence: MIT (github.com/chakra-ui/chakra-ui, Copyright 2019 Chakra Systems Inc.). Studied @chakra-ui/react 3.37.0 at commit f799e4d (2026-10-06).
bestFor: SaaS product UI and dashboards where semantic status colours and consistent variants matter more than brand drama
teams that want a token-first system they can retheme by overriding semantic tokens (bg, fg, border, colorPalette.*)
projects that benefit from a large, uniformly specced component set with the same variant x size grid
avoidFor: expressive brand or editorial sites (default is deliberately neutral zinc with a 4px radius)
teams unwilling to run a runtime emotion-free but token-codegen toolchain (CLI typegen, next-themes)
anything that needs a bundled typeface (Inter is named but not shipped)

families: heading: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, emoji stack
typography.notes: Font sizes are tokens (2xs 0.625rem ... 9xl 8rem; textStyles exist for 2xs-7xl). A textStyle bundles fontSize + lineHeight (+ letterSpacing -0.025em from 4xl up), so a size cannot be used without its leading. Line-height tokens: shorter 1.25, short 1.375, moderate 1.5, tall 1.625, taller 2; html default 1.5. Font weights thin 100 ... black 900; Heading is semibold 600, Button/Badge/Tabs/label medium 500, Card title semibold. global CSS enables fontFeatureSettings "cv11" (Inter single-storey a) on all elements. Badge uses fontVariantNumeric tabular-nums. Letter spacing tokens: tighter -0.05em, tight -0.025em, wide 0.025em, wider 0.05em, widest 0.1em. Inter is named in the stack but not bundled; the app must load it.

accents.note: 11 steps 50-950. Note 700-950 are hand-tuned deep, desaturated tones (not simple Tailwind values) for dark-mode surfaces.

palette exceptions.yellow.contrast: black in both modes; yellow.solid = yellow.300 in both modes

color.darkMode: Semantic tokens carry {_light, _dark} pairs (conditions are selector-based: .dark / .light class from next-themes). Components never reference raw scales; they reference colorPalette.{solid, contrast, fg, subtle, muted, emphasized, focusRing, border}, resolved per mode. Dark mode is a different mapping of the same 11-step ramps (subtle = 900, muted = 800, fg = 300) not an inversion function. Shadows get a dark counterpart (black/64 drop + 1px inset light edge gray.300/20-30). html default colour palette is gray.
color.contrastNotes: Measured (this study): white on blue.600 solid = 5.17:1; white on red.600 = 4.83:1; yellow.300 solid with black = 15.09:1 (explicit black contrast token); blue.700 on blue.100 (fg on subtle) = 7.63:1; fg.muted gray.600 on white = 7.73:1; fg.muted dark (gray.400 on black) = 7.76:1; fg.subtle gray.400 on white = 2.56:1 (decorative or placeholder only; placeholder is fg.muted at 80% opacity). Solid 600 and a per-palette contrast token (white, black, or mode-dependent) is the contrast mechanism; no luminance formula is used.

spacing.base: 0.25rem (4px). Numeric keys = multiples of 4px with half steps 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5.

radius.rule: Semantic radius layers: l1 = radii.xs (2px), l2 = radii.sm (4px), l3 = radii.md (6px). Controls (Button, Input, Badge, Tabs trigger, Tag) use l2; containers (Card, Alert, Tabs enclosed list) use l3; l1 sits inside l2/l3 for nested elements. Retheming the character of the whole system = re-point three tokens.

shadows: xs: 0 1px 2px gray.900/10, 0 0 1px gray.900/20 (dark: 0 1px 1px black/64, 0 0 1px inset gray.300/20)
inner: inset 0 2px 4px 0 black/5; inset: inset 0 0 0 1px black/5
depth.borders: Border width tokens: xs 0.5px, sm 1px, md 2px, lg 4px, xl 8px (solid). Default component border 1px solid semantic border (gray.200 | gray.800). 'surface' and 'outline' variants draw their border as inset box-shadow (0 0 0 1px) in colorPalette.muted/border rather than a CSS border, so layout does not shift.
depth.blur: blurs tokens: sm 4px, md 8px, lg 12px, xl 16px, 2xl 24px, 3xl 40px, 4xl 64px (used via backdropBlur on overlays/dialog backdrop).

motion.notes: Duration tokens: fastest 50, faster 100, fast 150, moderate 200, slow 300, slower 400, slowest 500. Interactive controls transition the 'common' property bundle (background-color, border-color, color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow, translate, transform) at 'moderate' 200ms. Presence animations are animationStyles (slide-fade-in/out, scale-fade-in/out, fade, slide-from-*) with data-state selectors: dialog/accordion/collapsible/tree-view 'moderate', tooltip 'fast', popover 'fast' in / 'faster' out, menu 'fast' in / 'faster' out, select 'fast' in / 'fastest' out (exit is faster than enter). Spinner rotates at 'slowest'. Skeleton shimmer 1.2s. Reduced motion is not a built-in token concern.

list: (+ layout primitives: Box, Flex, Grid, Stack, Wrap, Center, Float, Bleed, Group, Span, Square, Circle, Spacer, SimpleGrid, Sticky, VisuallyHidden)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Recipes encode a uniform grid: 76 recipe files = 19 single-part recipes (e.g. Button, Input, Badge, Textarea, Kbd, Link, Heading, Spinner, Skeleton) + 57 slot recipes (e.g. Card, Tabs, Alert, Checkbox, Dialog, Menu, Select). Axes: variant (typically solid, subtle, surface, outline, ghost, plain; Input: outline, subtle, flushed; Card: elevated, outline, subtle) x size (Button/Input 2xs..2xl; Badge xs..lg; Card/Tabs sm..lg) x colorPalette (any of the 10 palettes; status prop for Alert). States via conditions on the same recipe: _hover, _expanded, _selected, _checked, _invalid, _disabled (layerStyle disabled = opacity .5 + cursor disabled), focusVisibleRing (outside = 2px at 2px offset; inside = 1px at 0; mixed = 3px at 40% alpha). Hover is derived per variant (solid: solid/90; subtle/surface: muted; outline/ghost: subtle). No pressed/active state tokens; no compoundVariants used in the shipped recipes (colour comes from colorPalette instead of variant x color compounds). Defaults are declared (size md, variant solid).

tokenArchitecture: Panda-derived styled-system. Layers: (1) tokens: raw scales (colors gray/red/.., fonts, fontSizes, fontWeights, letterSpacings, lineHeights, radii, spacing, sizes, durations, easings, blurs, borders, zIndex, cursor, animations, aspectRatios). (2) semanticTokens with {_light,_dark} conditions and DEFAULT-nesting: bg.*, fg.*, border.*, per-palette {contrast, fg, subtle, muted, emphasized, solid, focusRing, border}, shadows xs-2xl, radii l1/l2/l3. (3) styles: textStyles (size + leading + tracking), layerStyles (fill.muted, fill.subtle, fill.surface, fill.solid, outline.*, indicator.*, disabled), animationStyles. (4) recipes and slot recipes: base + variants (size, variant, ...) + defaultVariants + optional compoundVariants; slot recipes key styles by anatomy part (root, label, control...). (5) colorPalette: a virtual colour set on any element (colorPalette="blue") that makes colorPalette.solid etc. resolve to that palette, so the same recipe serves every hue. Tokens referenced as {colors.blue.600} and opacity-modified as {colors.gray.900/10}. Conditions: _dark, _light, _hover, _focusVisible, _disabled, _expanded, _selected, _checked, _invalid, _horizontal, _vertical, _icon. Codegen CLI (typegen) types token names. Theme is built with createSystem(defaultConfig, defineConfig({theme: {tokens, semanticTokens, recipes}})). Layers named in CSS @layer: reset, base, tokens, recipes.
distinctiveness: Not visually distinctive by itself: zinc greys, Inter, 4px control radius, 1px borders, 40px control. Its distinction is architectural: the colorPalette contract (8 semantic roles per palette) and recipes whose axes are variant x size with palette as a third independent axis. v3 (Panda-style tokens, Ark UI behaviour) reads as a flat, tight, neutral aesthetic; the v2 comparison is from memory and was not verified in this pass.
weaknesses: Visually generic neutral: identity must come from fonts and palette overrides
Inter is referenced but not bundled; if missing the stack falls back to system fonts
No pressed/active tokens and no built-in reduced-motion policy
Letter-spacing and weight are not paired to size beyond 4xl+ tracking
Large size range (2xs-2xl) with several adjacent sizes sharing the same text style (sm and md both 14px), so the ladder is not strictly monotonic in type
fg.subtle (gray.400 on white) = 2.56:1 fails body-text contrast
Yellow, orange, and mode-dependent contrast tokens are exceptions that must be remembered per palette
Requires codegen (typegen) and a theming provider; recipes are CSS-in-JS-free but build-step dependent
takeaways: Give every colour the same 8-role contract (contrast, fg, subtle, muted, emphasized, solid, focusRing, border) so a recipe is written once and works for any hue.
Make colour a third axis (colorPalette) independent of variant and size, and avoid variant x colour compound explosions.
Use a semantic surface triad bg / fg / border with muted, subtle, emphasized steps plus status variants (error, warning, success, info) in both modes.
Couple font-size and line-height (and tracking for display sizes) in a text style so they can never be separated.
Define radius as three semantic layers (l1 inner, l2 control, l3 container) so nested radii are correct and a theme changes in three lines.
Draw outline/surface borders as inset box-shadow so adding or removing the border never shifts layout.
Treat focus as a recipe-level utility with three modes (outside, inside, mixed), using the palette's focusRing colour.
Make exit animations faster than enter animations (select fast in, fastest out; popover fast in, faster out).
